module: Flowgraph node "Create Button" (once_instant category): creates a button in the flowgraph 'button' module (self.mgr.modules.button:addButton) and outputs its identifier. Inputs: "label" (default 'Button'), "active" (hidden, true), "order" (hidden, empty = automatic order), "style" (hidden, 'default'). Output "buttonId" (number) to use with Get Button, Set Button Property, etc.

postInit.desc: Defines the value template of the style pin (only 'default').

workOnce.desc: Creates the button with label/active/order/style and writes its id to "buttonId".
